name: staff_skull
why: The necromancer's skull staff (gearlook.js staffShape 'staff_skull', every necromancer's own), made by Tripo in place of the one procgear.js builds in code.

image.prompt: Stylized low-poly fantasy necromancer staff, a single game prop shown whole, standing perfectly upright and vertical, centered, seen from the front. Twisted dark blackened wooden shaft with a wrapped dark leather grip a third of the way down and an iron spike at the foot. On top sits a large human skull facing the viewer, with glowing green eye sockets, held by an iron collar and a ring of small bones below it. Chunky readable shapes, big skull, hand-painted flat colours with soft light-to-dark gradients, no texture noise, no harsh shadows. Game-ready prop in the style of KayKit adventurers. Plain light grey background, nothing else in the picture. --no hands, character, text, multiple objects, cloth, chains
